QA-002 is closed. Every cargo step in .github/workflows/sc-agent-ci.yml has --locked. That includes cargo fetch, llvm-cov and llvm-cov report, doc, build, hack --each-feature, and the test steps. The only cargo steps without it are the two `cargo hack check ... --feature-powerset --no-dev-deps` steps, and the workflow comment at lines 274-277 explains why.

The exemption for those two steps is valid. I ran `cargo hack check --locked -p sc-decision-schema --feature-powerset --no-dev-deps` and it failed with 'cannot update the lock file ... because --locked was passed'. The same command without --locked succeeds and leaves Cargo.lock and the tree unchanged. So the failure comes from the Cargo.toml rewrite, not from lock drift. `cargo check --locked` on the same crate passes, and other steps in the features job still enforce the lock file. I did not run the sc-agent-types variant, which has the same --no-dev-deps shape.
